verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents staged percentage rollouts through a segment rule with a % Split condition that accepts values from 1 to 100. It also supports gradual percentage enablement globally or within a segment. Flag changes are made remotely without deploying new code, which covers ramping from 1% to 100%. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that bucketing is deterministic and stays consistent per user as the percentage grows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollout behavior.
